articles.summary: Donaldson delivered strong financial results in fiscal 2026, achieving record sales and earnings performance. Fourth-quarter sales increased 8% to $1.1 billion, supported by improved profitability and solid operational execution across the business. For the full fiscal year, sales reached $3.9 billion, representing a 5.3% increase compared to fiscal 2025. A key milestone during the year was the successful acquisition of Facet, which further strengthens Donaldson’s position in the durable aerospace, defense, and power generation markets. The acquisition contributed positively to sales and enhanced the company’s portfolio in key growth sectors.

articles.summary: Donaldson Company, Inc. (NYSE: DCI), a leading worldwide provider of innovative filtration products and solutions, today announced that Rich Lewis, president, and chief executive officer will present at the Jefferies 2026 Global Industrials Conference on Tuesday, September 9, 2026, beginning at 9:30 a.m. ET. Brad Pogalz, chief financial officer, will present at the Morgan Stanley 14 th Annual Laguna Conference on Tuesday, September 15, 2026, beginning at 1:00 p.m. ET. WEBCAST: To listen to a live webcast of the presentations, visit the “Events Presentations” section of Donaldson’s Investor Relations website at IR.Donaldson.com and click on the “listen to webcast” option. REPLAY: The webcast replays will be available within the “Events Presentations” section of Donaldson’s Investor Relations website for approximately 90 days following the event.
